mods.name: Overpowered Mobs
mods.description: Boosts vanilla mobs and adds overpowered gear.

releases.notes:
# What's new in 0.3.4

- Clean persisted OPM enhancements from saved giants
- Remove giant enhancements and exclude giants from mod systems
- Set creeper, pillager, and dragon boost chances
- Raise default mob boost chance to twenty percent
- Fix eleven audited gameplay, config, and release bugs

[Full changelog](https://github.com/evan6509/Overpowered-Mobs-2/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4)

Fabric only. Requirements: Minecraft >=26.2, Fabric Loader >=0.19.3, Fabric API >=0.154.2, Java >=25.

releases.notes:
# What's new in 0.3.3

- Preserve explicit legacy per-mob multipliers
- Make Endermen automatically aggressive toward nearby players
- Remove Blood Moon events and configuration
- Add a powerful player test sword command
- Prevent equipped gear drops and limit multiplication to loot tables
- Tame cavalry horses to prevent rider ejection
- Stabilize cavalry rotation after mob AI updates
- Fix audited mob behavior, config persistence, and release recovery
- Add automated Fabric releases and development workflow
- Fix mob combat, spawn, config, and event bugs
- Use player predicate compatible with the entity search API
- Fix mob combat timing, spawn initialization, and event tracking
- Apply damage multipliers to skeleton arrows
- Remove mob elytra assaults
- Stop elytra mobs relaunching on landing
- Fix grounded and mounted elytra mob poses
- Stabilize mounted mob rendering on client
- Fix cavalry mount control contention
- Stop tracking macOS metadata
- Stabilize cavalry render rotation
- Fix cavalry rider positioning and rotation
- Fix LivingEntity accessor for Minecraft 26.2
- Register accessor mixins correctly
- Avoid task-time Gradle project access
- Use current block support check for teleports
- Make test server deployment opt in
- Keep test mode spawns boosted during blood moons
- Reject invalid cavalry mount entities
- Preserve configured follow range scaling
- Land Endermen within teleport strike range
- Apply killer rabbit variant after spawning
- Multiply only drops from the dying mob
- Use vanilla mob totem protection
- Keep distance speed from blocking combat AI
- Fix phantom pack size redirect
- Add configurable elite and hostile mob mechanics

[Full changelog](https://github.com/evan6509/Overpowered-Mobs-2/compare/v0.3.2...v0.3.3)

Fabric only. Requirements: Minecraft >=26.2, Fabric Loader >=0.19.3, Fabric API >=0.154.2, Java >=25.
